Found 1 medium backend bug and a few minor UI issues.

critical.issue: Residual is not re-checked on (re)send. A scartata NC is excluded from residual, so another NC can consume the full residual; then re-sending the scartata NC succeeds -> over-storno. Reproduced: original 122 consegnata, NC1 122 scartata, NC2 122 created+sent, NC1 resent -> residuo_stornabile -122, dashboard fatturato -122. Fix: in send_sdi, for TD04 with fattura_collegata_id re-run the residual check (others non-scartata excluding self) before transmitting.

minor.issue: Residual check is read-then-insert (no atomicity): two concurrent NCs on the same invoice can both pass. Low risk.

notifiche[*].totale (SDI panel, e.g. 'Ricevuta di consegna 183,00 €') and recenti add NC totals as positive amounts mixed with invoices; totale_fatture ('Fatture totali (incl. bozze)') counts NCs too.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Invia allo SDI' in the editor the 'Crea nota di credito' button does not appear until page reload: send/refresh/PUT responses come from _get_invoice which lacks residuo_stornabile/note_credito, and setInv(data) overwrites them (inv.residuo_stornabile undefined > 0 is false). Fix: return the enriched invoice from backend (reuse get_invoice logic) or refetch GET /invoices/{id} after action().

Changing client on a NC keeps the old fattura_collegata_id (select shows empty) -> save fails with 'deve essere intestata allo stesso cliente'. selectClient should reset fattura_collegata_id when the linked invoice belongs to another party.

Prefill always copies full original lines even when residuo_stornabile < totale (e.g. after a partial NC), so the first save always fails with residual error. Consider showing the residual in the linked section / warning before save.
Sending a NC shows 'Fattura trasmessa all'intermediario (simulato)' - should use docName ('Nota di credito trasmessa').
